sentence_patterns.pattern: Going from junior high school to senior high school is a really big challenge.

sentence_patterns.example: 美国高中学制多为四年，采取学分制，不分文理科，一般按要求完成相应学分可以获得高中毕业证书。

sentence_patterns.translation: 我们强烈建议学生读一些来自英语国家的真实生活读物。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Every Wednesday, we work at a soup kitchen and hand out food to homeless people in the community.
sentence_patterns.explain: soup kitchen的用法
sentence_patterns.example: soup kitchen是为救济贫民、灾民而设的食品施舍场所，这里通常有志愿者团体承办的、向救济对象免费发放或低于市价出售食品的活动。

sentence_patterns.pattern: You can then spend three days exploring the rainforest with a local guide and enjoying the plants and animals unique to the rainforest.

sentence_patterns.pattern: One of the best players had been injured, and the team captain had to leave because of heart problems.

sentence_patterns.pattern: The Boys and Girls Club which he started in Chicago has been helping young people since 1996.

sentence_patterns.example: The Boys and Girls Club which he started in Chicago has been helping young people since 1996.
sentence_patterns.translation: 他（乔丹）在芝加哥所创建的‘男孩女孩俱乐部’从1996年至今一直在帮助年轻人。

sentence_patterns.pattern: I tried no-fat, low-fat, 5:2, only bananas, no bananas—I almost went bananas, too.

sentence_patterns.pattern: It seemed as if the world were coming to an end!
sentence_patterns.explain: As if is a conjunction used to introduce a clause meaning 'as though; it looks as if'. The clause can be in indicative or subjunctive mood depending on the truth or possibility of the statement.
sentence_patterns.example: The pot is smoking. It looks as if the food is overcooked.
sentence_patterns.translation: 锅在冒烟，看样子食物都煮过头啦。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Nearly one third of the whole nation felt it!
sentence_patterns.explain: One third is used to express 'one third'. In English, fractions are formed by combining a cardinal number (one, two, ...) with an ordinal number (first, second, ...). When the numerator is greater than one, the ordinal number is pluralized.
sentence_patterns.example: If an apple is cut into six equal slices, each slice is called one sixth. If you eat two slices, you eat two sixths or one third.
sentence_patterns.translation: 如果一个苹果被平分为六块，每块就是六分之一。如果你吃掉两块，就是吃掉了六分之二或三分之一。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Everywhere survivors looked, there was nothing but ruins.
sentence_patterns.explain: Everywhere is used as a conjunction to introduce a subordinate clause. It means 'every place; anywhere'.
sentence_patterns.example: Everywhere we go, we hear people predicting the election results.
sentence_patterns.translation: 无论我们走到哪里，都听见人们在预测选举结果。

sentence_patterns.pattern: the dead
sentence_patterns.explain: The + adjective form of a noun is used to express a person or thing with the characteristics or state indicated by the adjective. These nouns are collective concepts and are used without plural endings, often treated as plural.
sentence_patterns.example: The old sometimes help the young to enrich their social experiences.
sentence_patterns.translation: 长者有时帮助年轻人丰富社会阅历。

sentence_patterns.pattern: the number of deaths stood at 2,498
sentence_patterns.explain: Stand at sth is used to indicate reaching a certain level (or quantity, height, etc.).
sentence_patterns.example: It is said that the highest death toll caused by a lightning strike stands at 91.
sentence_patterns.translation: 据说，被雷电击中造成死亡的最高纪录为91人。

sentence_patterns.pattern: It dates back several thousand years to the use of longgu ...
sentence_patterns.explain: date back常和to搭配，意为“追溯到……”，相当于date from。
sentence_patterns.example: His family history dates back to the 1700s.
sentence_patterns.translation: 他的家族历史可以追溯到18世纪。

sentence_patterns.pattern: no matter (what/how/where/when/whether) …
sentence_patterns.explain: 是一个引导让步状语从句的连词结构，意为“无论（什么、怎样、哪里、何时、是否等）……”，可置于句首、句中和句尾。
sentence_patterns.example: No matter how fast the rabbit ran, it could not escape the big grey wolf.
sentence_patterns.translation: 无论这兔子跑多快，都无法逃过那大灰狼。

sentence_patterns.pattern: Chinese calligraphy
sentence_patterns.explain: 书法是使书写优美的艺术。中国书法具有独特的艺术价值和悠久的历史，早在两千多年前就发展为一种艺术形式。
sentence_patterns.example: 书法字体多样，最为知名的有楷书、行书、草书、隶书、篆书等。
sentence_patterns.translation: 书法字体多样，最为知名的有楷书、行书、草书、隶书、篆书等。

sentence_patterns.pattern: a number of
sentence_patterns.explain: 意为“很多；好些”，这时number 还可被large、small、good、growing 等形容词修饰。
sentence_patterns.example: A good number of my classmates agree with me.
sentence_patterns.translation: 我班上的不少同学都赞同我（的意见）。

sentence_patterns.pattern: I can never quite get the main idea.
sentence_patterns.explain: 这是英语口语中的常用表达，句中never quite get sth意指说话人往往能听懂部分词句，但不敢保证完全听明白了。
sentence_patterns.example: I’m afraid I can’t always quite get what he says.
sentence_patterns.translation: 我担心自己总是不能完全听懂他说的话。

sentence_patterns.pattern: so I only need a few words to bridge the gap between us.
sentence_patterns.explain: 句中bridge作动词，表示“减小、消除两者间的隔阂、鸿沟或分歧”。
sentence_patterns.example: The differences between two cultures can always be bridged if the people of these areas continue to communicate.
sentence_patterns.translation: 只要两种文化地域的人们不断交流沟通，两种文化间的差异总是可以缩小的。
